timeline.evidenceText: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.
Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
Judgment has come on the plain country,
From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh,

definitions.short: Jahats or Jahtsah , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H3096. Yahats יַ֫הְצָה יַ֫הַץ, proper name, of a location in Moab , site unknown (MI 19, 20 יהץ ) — יהץ Isa 15:4 ; Jer 48:34 ; with ה locative יָהְ֑צָה , on border of territory of Amorites (under Sihon) Num 21:23 ; Deut 2:32 ; also בְּיָהְ֑צָה Judg 11:20 ; called יַהֲצָ֫ה Josh 13:18 (assigned to Reuben); יַ֫הְצָה 1Chr 6:63 (Levitical city in Reuben), Jer 48:21 . יהר (√ of following; compare Late Hebrew יָהַר Hithpa`el shew oneself haughty , adjective יָהִיר ; Aramaic יְהַר Pa`el be haughty , adjective יְהִירָא ; compare Arabic be insane ).
definitions.rootNote: or יַהְצָה ; or (feminine) יַהְצָה ; from an unused root meaning to stamp ; perhaps threshing -floor;
